name: Spree River
description: The river weaving through Berlin's heart, lined with landmarks and boat tours from Museum Island to the East Side.

name: Reichstag Dome
description: Norman Foster's glass dome crowning the German parliament; free entry, advance registration required.

name: TV Tower, Berlin
description: Berlin's tallest structure at Alexanderplatz with a 360-degree observation deck and revolving restaurant.

name: Reichstag
description: Home of the German Parliament since 1894, an iconic neoclassical pile with a transparent modern dome.

name: Friedrichstadt-Palast
description: Europe's largest show palace, stages spectacular revues right at the turn of Friedrichstraße.

name: Madame Tussauds Berlin
description: Wax museum on Unter den Linden with lifelike figures of political, pop and royal icons.

name: Berlin Zoo
description: One of Germany's oldest zoos, famed for its iconic Elephant Gate entrance on Kurfürstendamm.

name: Olympic Stadium, Berlin
description: The 1936 Olympic venue now hosting Hertha BSC football and major athletics events in West Berlin.

name: Jewish Museum Berlin
description: Daniel Libeskind's architecture is as powerful an exhibit as the two millennia of Jewish history inside.

name: Berlin Wall
description: The preserved wall section and memorial on Bernauer Straße tell the story of the city's division.

name: Hitler's Bunker
description: The unmarked car park where the Führerbunker once stood; an information board traces the site's dark history.

name: Friedrichstraße
description: Berlin's famous shopping boulevard, anchored by the elegant Friedrichstraße railway station.

name: DeJa Vu Museum, Berlin
description: A quirky subculture museum exploring déjà vu experiences and perception in Prenzlauer Berg.

name: DARK MATTER, Berlin
description: Immersive light-art installation space in Kreuzberg dissecting perception and illusion.

name: Reichstag Plenary Chambers
description: Inner chamber of the German Bundestag, visitable alongside the dome during registered tours.

name: LEGOLAND Discovery Centre, Berlin
description: Indoor brick playground at Potsdamer Platz with rides, a 4D cinema and miniature Berlin built from Lego.

name: Estrel Showtheater
description: Europe's largest entertainment venue staging large-scale musical spectacles in Neukölln's Estrel hotel.

name: Jannowitz Bridge
description: A Spree crossing between Mitte and Kreuzberg, framed by river views and boat traffic.

name: Lake Tegel
description: Lakeside contemplation and swimming beaches just north of the city, framed by water-side walks.

name: Olympic Stadium, Berlin
description: The 1936 Olympic venue now hosting Hertha BSC football and major athletics events in West Berlin.
